semantics.queue_id: Only exact public queue/project/case identifiers supported by source evidence are asserted.
semantics.service_record: Utility/service/contract evidence is kept separate from queue IDs and from measured IT load.
semantics.no_match_found: No site-specific queue/service/interconnection case was located in the reviewed public source set as of 2026-09-26; it does not establish that the site is unconnected.
semantics.capacity: Epoch IT MW, queue MW, service/contract MW and planning MW are stored as distinct fields and are not silently substituted.
